After the fault is isolated to a particular circuit voltage, current and resistance measurements can be done to find the bad component. In this lesson you are not required to find the failed component. Let's start the experiment.
If the fault is in the receiver, oscilloscope measurements on TP3, TP6, TP10 and TP11 will isolate the fault to either the RF amp, demodulator or AF amp.
If the fault is in the transmitter, oscilloscope measurements on TP1, TP2 and TP3 will isolate the fault to either the oscillator or varactor diode circuit.
If the fault is in the transmission medium, checking out the antenna or transmission cables will normally locate the failure.
If an attenuated FM signal is present on Pin E, the fault is in the receiver.
If an attenuated FM signal is not present on Pin E, the fault is in the transmission medium.
Second, measure the input to the receiver..................
If the FM signal is not present, the transmitter is faulted.
If the FM signal is present on Pin T, the transmitter circuit must be operating correctly.
First, measure the output of the transmitter.
This is accomplished by making two simple oscilloscope measurements.
Once you have determined that the FM system is not operating correctly, you must then isolate the fault to either the transmitter, transmission medium or receiver.
If you do not have a good signal on PC130-90 Pin T, the FM system is faulted.
If you have a good signal on PC130-90 Pin T, the transmitter and receiver must be operating correctly.
This is accomplished by measuring the output of the receiver with the oscilloscope.
To locate a faulted circuit, you must first determine if the FM system is operating correctly.
It contains a RF amplifier circuit, demodulator circuit and an AF amplifier circuit.
The receiver is located on the PC130-90 card...............
It contains an oscillator circuit, varactor diode and a VCO modulator.
The transmitter is located on the PC130-86 card............
In this experiment, you should locate a failed circuit in an FM ratio demodulator transmitter and receiver system.
